name: ammonia
uses: Uses: For the temporary relief of fainting. For the temporary stimulation of the senses to restore alertness.
otcwarn: Warnings: For external use only. Do not use if you have breathing problems such as asthma or emphysema. Do not place directly inside the nostrils. When using this product do not exceed recommended dosage. Keep away from fire or flame. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition persists or worsens. If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.
